text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"『Hey City! Wanna take purikura? I found 
one that makes you look insane. You'll 
look hilarious with the over-the-top 
filters, right? Just Jordan~! Let's go!』"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"—But you just barged in without thinking 
about any of that. 
Whenever I rejected people, they usually 
backed off. Because they didn't care about 
the real me."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"『Hey, isn't this place super tasty? Cute 
and delicious is the best! By the way, 
today's class made zero sense, didn't 
it... Ah, my nail is chipping!』"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"You were such a hardcore idiot... and you 
didn't care at all. 
You just dragged me around everywhere like 
it was the most natural thing in the 
world."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...It made me realize how fun hanging out 
with friends could be. 
Thanks to you, I made more friends... and 
I was super happy, you know."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"When I saw you crying while quietly 
repainting your nails... 
I was surprised."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"『—...Why are they so weak? Stupid 
nails... Hang in there. 
Let me try hard. Don't... don't make me 
hate myself...』"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"You were cursing under your breath, but 
repainting them with so much care. Seeing 
that made me think... she's fighting too. 
She's not giving up, either—"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Jordan, you're super cool too. 
That's why... I wanted to become real 
friends with you."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Even for the Summer Walk... I finally 
managed to convince my manager. 
Do you have any idea how much I...—"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...No. Expecting you to just understand 
might be spoiled of me. 
But that's only because it's you... and 
so... um."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...Aaaah! City, you always overthink 
things way too much, osu! 
You don't have to say it nicely! Just 
shout it out, osu!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Ngh............ That's why, Jordan is... 
my. 
My... ...friend. ...And..."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "—...M-My best friend! That's why~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Cityyyy~~...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...*sigh*. From now on, if something's 
bothering you... tell me right away. 
...I will too. ...I don't wanna hurt a 
precious friend ever again!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "Yeah...! Yeah, yeah...!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Also... I'm sorry about earlier! I acted 
like a jerk. Thinking you were keeping 
secrets from me just pissed me off so 
much... I was such a brat."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine! You're always twice as nice 
back to me, City... You always forgive all 
my stupid mistakes... So seriously, don't 
worry about it!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sorry too! I got all in my head and 
thought dumb, annoying stuff like, 'City 
doesn't even care about hanging out with 
me...'"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ah... That's—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"WOOOOO!! THIS is what youth is all 
about!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SPLAAAASH!!)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"WHAAAT?! Did she seriously just dive 
in?!"

text_block_list.name: Helios & Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"YAAAY☆ 
Operation Youth: Total Success!!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Huh? Wait, operation...? Wait, you don't 
mean...?!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Jordan and City, bestie besties, totally 
hyped♪ 
Friends forever is the ultimate win☆ 
Right, Palmer-chin!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Hehe, totally! But hey, Bamboo's not 
stopping, you know? Captain, what's the 
plan?!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Obviously...! 
*Deep breath*...!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I love Bamboo! City's the best! Jordan's 
my fave! And Palmer-chin... 
I love you all soooo much! Now everyone 
dive in, say HOOO♪"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: GYAAAAAAHHH?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SPLAAAASH!!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Hell yeah, the ocean rocks☆ 
Jordan, City, bring it on♪"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Guess we just gotta dive in headfirst! 
Hyah♪ ...Ahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Wait... seriously?! Hehe... Ugh, I'm 
completely soaked! 
What am I gonna do about my best 
outfit...?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Well, want to go change now?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "Now...? Wait, what? Huh?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"—Phew... Holy crap. Don't we look super 
high-class right now? 
Also... if you had dinner planned, you 
should've said so sooner!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"It wouldn't have been a surprise if I 
told you. The plan was originally to spend 
the whole day living luxuriously at the 
hotel, though."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, this is so Insta-worthy! And this 
one-piece is... super cute. 
I thought... you hated matching outfits?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Did I ever say I hated it? ...Jordan, you 
trust my taste, right? So of course I'm 
gonna put real effort into picking them 
out."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Ugh. Seriously, you gotta say that 
stuff out loud! ...Thank you. 
I'm so happy... and yet I was just being 
totally selfish..."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"What are you talking about? Presents Day 
was super fun. 
Anyway, let's make a toast already! ...Um, 
what should we say—"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"—To our friendship! Cheers! ...That's 
gotta be it! 
Hehe...♪"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"—Aww, the Summer Walk ends tomorrow, 
huh~. 
So sad~... City's sad too~... Yep. 
...Wait, huh?!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Is your folder full? You need to clean up 
your storage. 
Why don't you delete useless videos for 
now? Upload them to the cloud...—"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, you two are completely back to 
normal! Splendid, splendid! 
The Summer Walk is ending soon, so make 
sure to enjoy it till the very end!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Okaaaay... Wait, she's already gone. 
That girl is seriously on patrol 24/7. 
What happened to refreshing herself?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, so like, shouldn't we do 
something to thank her? Since she was 
looking out for us. 
We can worry about Palmer and Helios 
later."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Totally... A thank-you for Bamboo-senpai, 
huh. 
...Oh, how about this?"
